qa_pairs.question: What torque should be applied to the M6 screws when mounting the radiator to the body?
What is the torque specification for the drain plug on the radiator?
How much torque is required for the temperature switch to radiator connection?
What is the maximum temperature rating specified for the temperature switch to radiator?
Which component has the highest torque specification in the radiator mounting section?
qa_pairs.answer: The temperature switch to radiator at 15 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Do all the radiator and mounting parts specifications apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all specifications show 'All' in the Type column

qa_pairs.question: What is the lowest torque specification listed for radiator components?
qa_pairs.answer: 2.5 Nm for the drain plug on radiator

qa_pairs.question: Which two components share the same 9 Nm torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The radiator to body self-tapping screw (B6.3) and the expansion tank to body both require 9 Nm
